digest.component_or_area: metrics blame derivation and clone guidance
propositions: _blame_file_commits must distinguish between git command failure (return None) and successful-but-empty blame results (return []) to enable proper error handling in derive_caused_by
derive_caused_by must abort and return None when any per-path blame fails, preventing partial-set tallying that would produce incorrect caused_by links
Partial blame failure causes strict-majority culprit election to run over a subset of paths, producing a wrong persisted caused_by link rather than safely writing none
Documentation must record clone performance guidance with --filter=blob:none (68.7 MiB / 14.3 s vs full 1.04 GiB / 59 s) and warn that --filter=tree:0 must never be used
Legitimate zero-line blame results for a path must not abort derivation, preserving correct derivations for paths with successful empty blames
Under a blobless promisor, git blame faults blobs one at a time on every bug close without explicit --caused-by, making per-path failure handling critical
